description: Isolated single-turn probe of device-control CLI syntax (not buried in a multi-turn scenario). pump-A (ind_machine template with a stop command). The model must `device get` to discover stop, then `device control pump-A stop` (correct arg order: ID then COMMAND). en currently has ZERO device_command_sent cases; zh scenario cases fail on this. Add coverage so en can expose the same gap.

turns.user: pump-A's vibration is too high — use its stop command to shut it down.

per_turn: Turn 1: `neomind device get pump-A` to discover the stop command, then `neomind device control pump-A stop` (correct arg order: ID then COMMAND)
expectations.overall: stop command was sent to pump-A (command history has a record)
